str.contains().part: The text to look for. The test is exact and case sensitive, and an empty `part` is contained in every string.

str.endsWith().part: The text the string must end with. The test is case sensitive, and an empty `part` is a suffix of every string.

str.indexOf().part: The text to find. The result is its first position counting from 0, or `-1` when it does not occur.

str.join().parts: The strings to join, in order. An absent element is written as the word `none`.
str.join().separator: The text written between each pair of parts, such as `", "`.

str.lower().s: The string to convert to small letters.

str.padLeft().width: The length in characters to pad to. A string already that long or longer comes back unchanged.
str.padLeft().fill: The text added on the left to reach the width. When it is longer than one character it repeats and is cut to fit.

str.padRight().width: The length in characters to pad to. A string already that long or longer comes back unchanged.
str.padRight().fill: The text added on the right to reach the width. When it is longer than one character it repeats and is cut to fit.

str.repeat().n: The number of copies, a whole number of 0 or more. A negative or fractional count stops the study with `OS4003`.

str.replace().find: The text to look for, matched exactly. Only its first occurrence is replaced.
str.replace().with: The text put in place of `find`.

str.replaceAll().find: The text to look for, matched exactly. Every occurrence is replaced, from left to right.
str.replaceAll().with: The text put in place of each occurrence. It is not searched again.

str.split().separator: The text to split at. It is not kept in the pieces, and an empty separator splits the string into single characters.

str.startsWith().part: The text the string must begin with. The test is case sensitive, and an empty `part` is a prefix of every string.

str.substring().from: The position to start at, counting from 0. A negative or fractional position stops the study with `OS4003`.
str.substring().to: The position to stop before, which is not included. Left out, everything to the end is taken, and a `to` past the end is cut back to the end.

str.upper().s: The string to convert to capitals.
